description: Land Acquisition - Nallandaluwa, Mundalama D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that a specific parcel of land (0.1685 Hectare in Nallandaluwa village) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses exclusively on land matters, specifically the acquisition of property, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While a government minister is named, the notice does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (it only states his title) and the primary subject is land acquisition, not government personnel or structure.
